# Powerchair Floorball Battle (PCF BATTLE)

> Official website for the Powerchair Floorball Battle, an international club tournament for powerchair floorball in Leuven, Belgium.

The tournament takes place on 1–2 May 2027 at Sportoase Philipssite Arena in Leuven, Belgium. The planned competition has eight teams in two groups, played on one court across two days. The official website is the source for registration, tournament rules, practical information, schedules and updates.

## Official information

- [Homepage](https://www.pcfbattle.be/): Event overview, registration information and announcements.
- [Practical information](https://www.pcfbattle.be/practical): Venue, accommodation, accessibility, participation information and competition format.
- [FAQ](https://www.pcfbattle.be/faq): Answers to common questions.
- [Contact](https://www.pcfbattle.be/contact): Official contact channels.
- [Tournament schedule](https://www.pcfbattle.be/tournament/schedule): Match schedule, when published.
- [Standings](https://www.pcfbattle.be/tournament/standings): Tournament standings, when published.
- [Brackets](https://www.pcfbattle.be/tournament/brackets): Knockout and placement matches, when published.
- [Live matches](https://www.pcfbattle.be/tournament/live): Live match information, when available.

## Additional resources

- [Sitemap](https://www.pcfbattle.be/sitemap.xml): Discover currently published public pages.
- [Accessibility](https://www.pcfbattle.be/accessibility): Accessibility information.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.pcfbattle.be/privacy): Data handling.
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.pcfbattle.be/terms): Participation terms.

Pages for live competition data may be unavailable until the organiser publishes them. Do not treat schedules, results, team participation or prices as confirmed unless they appear on the official website.
